_doc: Technology Gates. Built from compact specs; see CLAUDE.md > Gates.

gates.name: the Clockwork Foundry
gates.description: A pre-Fracture workshop, dug out of a hillside near the village, ticks like a giant pocket watch.
gates.entry_text: Brass gears turn in the walls. Every machine in here is still running, and none of them remember why.

rooms.text: Brass spiders drop from the gears overhead, clicking.
A corridor of swinging hammers, timed to the ticking.

check.success: You count the ticks and slip through, and pick a cog from the floor on the far side.
check.fail: You mistime it, and a hammer clips your shoulder.

rooms.text: Rivet drones buzz out of a vent, spitting hot nails.

clockwork_foundry_automaton.title: the Foreman Automaton
clockwork_foundry_automaton.intro: A brass giant stands at a workbench, endlessly assembling and disassembling the same toy bird. It turns its lantern head toward you. 'SHIFT NOT OVER,' it says.
clockwork_foundry_automaton.victory: The Foreman winds down mid-sentence: 'SHIFT... NOT...'

study.text: Its key is in its back. Get behind it and it can't reach.

clockwork_foundry_tinker_gnome.title: Tinker {name}
clockwork_foundry_tinker_gnome.intro: A gnome in welding goggles has moved into the foundry and declared herself its owner. Tinker {name} has rebuilt the drones. She has improved them.
clockwork_foundry_tinker_gnome.victory: Tinker {name} drops her remote and runs for the vents, shouting about patents.
clockwork_foundry_tinker_gnome.arrival_omen: Someone has left a sign on the Mainspring Hall door: UNDER NEW MANAGEMENT. KNOCK.
clockwork_foundry_tinker_gnome.arrival_rumour: A gnome has taken over the Clockwork Foundry. She is selling drones to anyone who asks, and some who don't.

study.text: Her remote control is in her apron. Grab it.

clockwork_foundry_spark_ghost.title: the Spark in the Machine
clockwork_foundry_spark_ghost.intro: Your magic leaked into the foundry's gears, and something woke up in the current. It moves from machine to machine, wearing them like coats.
clockwork_foundry_spark_ghost.victory: The Spark fizzles out in a shower of blue light, and the machines stop, all at once.
clockwork_foundry_spark_ghost.arrival_omen: Blue light crawls along the gears of the Mainspring Hall. The machines move when no one is watching.
clockwork_foundry_spark_ghost.arrival_rumour: Something is alive in the wires of the Clockwork Foundry. It switches the machines on at night.

study.text: It can only live in one machine at a time. Wreck its host before it jumps.

clockwork_foundry_mainspring.title: the Mainspring Colossus
clockwork_foundry_mainspring.intro: The foundry has built itself a new foreman: bigger, uglier, made of every broken part on the floor.
clockwork_foundry_mainspring.victory: The Colossus collapses into its parts, and a single gear rolls to your feet.
clockwork_foundry_mainspring.arrival_omen: The foundry is running full shifts with no one in it. Something big is on the assembly line.
clockwork_foundry_mainspring.arrival_rumour: The Clockwork Foundry has built something huge from scrap, and it has started to walk.

study.text: It is built from scrap. Its welds are weak.

gates.name: the Golem Assembly Line
gates.description: A rift into a factory that made war golems for a kingdom that no longer exists. The line still runs.
gates.entry_text: Conveyor belts carry stone limbs past you in an endless procession. A loudspeaker announces quotas in a dead language.

rooms.text: Half-built golems climb off the belt, one arm each, to see what you are.
A bin of rejected cores. One still glows.

check.success: You pick out the one good core without touching the faulty ones.
check.fail: A faulty core discharges into your hand.

rooms.text: An inspector drone flags you as a defective product.

golem_assembly_overseer.title: the Overseer
golem_assembly_overseer.intro: A golem with four arms and a clipboard grafted to one of them stands above the line. 'QUALITY CONTROL,' it says, and grinds toward you.
golem_assembly_overseer.victory: The Overseer's clipboard clatters to the floor. The line stops.

study.text: Its orders come from a speaker above. Smash the speaker and it hesitates.

aftermath.label: Leave the line running.
aftermath.text: The belts start up again behind you. The factory will build what it needs.

aftermath.label: Jam the line with the Overseer's body.
aftermath.text: Gears grind and smoke. The factory falls quiet, and the golems on the belt stop moving.

golem_assembly_prototype.title: Prototype Omega
golem_assembly_prototype.intro: The line made a new overseer, and this time it built it to fight. Prototype Omega has cannons where its hands should be.
golem_assembly_prototype.victory: Prototype Omega's cannons melt, and it topples off the line.
golem_assembly_prototype.arrival_omen: The belts are running faster. Something new is coming down the line, much bigger than the others.
golem_assembly_prototype.arrival_rumour: The Golem Assembly Line built a war machine. Its cannons can be heard from the village.

study.text: Its cannons overheat. Make it fire, then move.

golem_assembly_scrappers.title: the Scrapper Gang
golem_assembly_scrappers.intro: With the line dead, scavengers moved in. Boss {name} leads a gang who strip golems for parts and have reprogrammed a few to guard them.
golem_assembly_scrappers.victory: Boss {name} drops the whistle, and the golems wander off to resume work no one gave them.
golem_assembly_scrappers.arrival_omen: Cut-open golems lie all along the silent belt. Someone has been stripping them for parts.
golem_assembly_scrappers.arrival_rumour: Scrappers have moved into the dead Golem Assembly Line, and they've reprogrammed the golems.

study.text: The reprogrammed golems obey a whistle. Get the whistle.

golem_assembly_core_mind.title: the Core Mind
golem_assembly_core_mind.intro: All the factory's golem cores have fused into one glowing mind at the center of the bay. Every golem in the building moves when it thinks.
golem_assembly_core_mind.victory: The Core Mind shatters, and every golem in the factory sits down where it stands.
golem_assembly_core_mind.arrival_omen: The golem cores in the bay are glowing in sync, pulsing like a single heart.
golem_assembly_core_mind.arrival_rumour: The golems in the Assembly Line all move together now, like one mind. Nobody knows who's thinking.

study.text: It thinks with every core at once. Break the cooling pipes and it slows.

gates.name: the Derelict Skyship Meridian
gates.description: A flying ship from before the Fracture hangs in a rift above the forest, motionless, its running lights still blinking.
gates.entry_text: Rope ladders lead up through a hatch. Inside, the decks tilt slightly, and the engines hum a note that sets your teeth on edge.

rooms.text: Sky pirates are looting the cargo hold. They are not happy to share.
The engine room. A gangway runs over a drop to the forest far below, and the wind is strong.

check.success: You cross the gangway and pry a coil from the engine.
check.fail: A gust slams you into the rail. You hang on, barely.

rooms.text: Automated turrets on the gun deck swivel to track you.

derelict_skyship_captain.title: Captain {name} of the Meridian
derelict_skyship_captain.intro: Captain {name} took the derelict ship for her own. She stands at the wheel of a vessel that hasn't moved in three years and orders you to surrender.
derelict_skyship_captain.victory: Captain {name} goes over the rail on a rope and is gone into the clouds.

study.text: The ship's wheel controls the deck tilt. Get to it first.

derelict_skyship_first_mate.title: First Mate Grell
derelict_skyship_first_mate.intro: The Captain's first mate has taken the wheel, and the crew. Grell is a half-orc with a chain hook and no patience.
derelict_skyship_first_mate.victory: Grell's hook clangs to the deck. The crew loses heart.
derelict_skyship_first_mate.arrival_omen: The pirate flag is still flying, but a new name has been painted over the Captain's on the bridge door.
derelict_skyship_first_mate.arrival_rumour: The pirates of the Meridian have a new captain. He is meaner than the last.

study.text: His hook is on a chain. Get inside its reach.

derelict_skyship_ship_mind.title: MERIDIAN
derelict_skyship_ship_mind.intro: Your magic jolted the ship's mind awake. MERIDIAN speaks from every speaker on the bridge: 'INTRUDER. PREPARE FOR VENTING.'
derelict_skyship_ship_mind.victory: MERIDIAN's voice slows to a crawl. 'Thank... you...' it says, and falls silent.
derelict_skyship_ship_mind.arrival_omen: The ship's lights have all turned red. A voice on the intercom counts down from a number it never reaches.
derelict_skyship_ship_mind.arrival_rumour: The skyship over the forest has woken up. Its guns track anything that flies.

study.text: It cannot see the bridge itself; its cameras look outward. Fight under the console.

derelict_skyship_storm_wraith.title: the Storm-Wrecked Crew
derelict_skyship_storm_wraith.intro: The ship's original crew have come back, as the dead sometimes do: blue-lipped, soaked with rain that fell three years ago, led by their navigator.
derelict_skyship_storm_wraith.victory: The Navigator looks at the forest below and understands, finally. The crew fades.
derelict_skyship_storm_wraith.arrival_omen: Wet footprints on every deck, though no rain falls. Someone has been checking the charts.
derelict_skyship_storm_wraith.arrival_rumour: The ghosts of the skyship's first crew have taken it back. They are still trying to land.

study.text: They still think they're flying. Tell them they've landed.

gates.name: the Silent Archive
gates.description: A rift beneath Verath opens into a vault full of humming crystal pillars. The System's own records call it an ARCHIVE NODE, and then refuse to say more.
gates.entry_text: Each pillar holds a flicker of light that looks like a memory: a wedding, a battle, a child laughing. The air smells like ozone and old paper.

rooms.text: Wardens of silver light step out of the pillars and ask for your access code.
A security grid of blue light crosses the corridor in slow patterns.

check.success: You read the pattern like a sum and step through the gaps. A shard lies on the far side.
check.fail: The grid touches you. It burns, and the alarm sounds.

rooms.text: An index construct, a cabinet on legs, tries to file you away.

archive_vault_curator.title: the Curator
archive_vault_curator.intro: At the center of the stacks, an intelligence of white light shaped like a librarian looks up from an endless ledger. 'Your file is incomplete,' it says. 'Hold still.'
archive_vault_curator.victory: The Curator's light stutters and freezes on a single word: ERROR.

study.text: It is processing you. Do something it cannot predict.

aftermath.label: Leave the Archive running.
aftermath.text: The pillars dim, then brighten. The Archive will restore its own keeper.

aftermath.label: Pull the core crystal and read what the System hides.
aftermath.text: You see the Fracture from the inside for a single second. It is too much. You drop the crystal, and the Archive screams.

archive_vault_restored.title: the Curator, Restored
archive_vault_restored.intro: The Archive restored its keeper from backup, and the backup remembers how you killed it. It has prepared.
archive_vault_restored.victory: The Restored Curator crashes. Somewhere, a backup of the backup begins to load.
archive_vault_restored.arrival_omen: Lights flicker through the stacks in patterns, like a mind booting up.
archive_vault_restored.arrival_rumour: The Silent Archive under Verath has restored its Curator. It remembers everyone who visited.

study.text: The backup is older than the original. It doesn't know about your newest tricks.

archive_vault_corrupted.title: the Corrupted Index
archive_vault_corrupted.intro: You broke the Archive's core. What is left is a mad thing of broken memories, wearing the faces of everyone stored inside it.
archive_vault_corrupted.victory: The Corrupted Index falls silent, and a thousand stolen memories drift out of it like sparks.
archive_vault_corrupted.arrival_omen: The pillars flicker with broken memories, the same moments over and over: a door, a scream, a door.
archive_vault_corrupted.arrival_rumour: Something broke in the Silent Archive under Verath. Now it shows people memories that aren't theirs.

study.text: It doesn't know which memories are its own. Remind it of one.

archive_vault_system_auditor.title: a System Auditor
archive_vault_system_auditor.intro: The System itself has noticed the trouble. An Auditor stands in the stacks: a figure with no face, only a blinking cursor where a face should be.
archive_vault_system_auditor.victory: The Auditor's cursor blinks once, slowly, and it closes like a window.
archive_vault_system_auditor.arrival_omen: A notification sits in the empty Core Stacks: AUDIT SCHEDULED.
archive_vault_system_auditor.arrival_rumour: The System has sent an Auditor into the Silent Archive. Nobody has ever seen one before.

study.text: It runs on rules. Give it a contradiction.

gates.name: the Lightning Engine
gates.description: A copper spire stands in a rift west of Verath, wrapped in coils and crowned with a crackling sphere. Birds that fly near it never land again.
gates.entry_text: Every hair on your body stands up. Blue sparks jump from your fingertips to the copper walls.

rooms.text: Arc drones float between the coils, shooting lightning at anything that moves.
A floor of copper plates, some of them live.

check.success: You pick the dead plates by instinct and find a charged capacitor at the end.
check.fail: You step on a live plate and the jolt throws you across the room.

rooms.text: Hounds of crackling copper bound out of a charging bay.

storm_engine_engineer.title: Chief Engineer {name}
storm_engine_engineer.intro: A woman in a rubber coat with lightning dancing on her gauntlets stands at the master switch. 'I'm so close,' says Chief Engineer {name}. 'One more surge and I'll own the sky.'
storm_engine_engineer.victory: Chief Engineer {name} throws the switch as she falls, and the spire goes dark.

study.text: Her gauntlets draw from the spire. Break the cable on her back.

storm_engine_apprentices.title: the Engine Apprentices
storm_engine_apprentices.intro: The Engineer's apprentices have restarted the spire to finish her work. They don't really know how it works, which makes them dangerous.
storm_engine_apprentices.victory: Senior Apprentice Kel drops the notes. The spire sputters.
storm_engine_apprentices.arrival_omen: The spire's lights flicker on again, unevenly, like someone is reading the manual.
storm_engine_apprentices.arrival_rumour: Someone has restarted the Lightning Engine. Badly. The spire west of Verath sparks all night.

study.text: They are reading from her notes. Steal the notes.

storm_engine_living_storm.title: the Living Storm
storm_engine_living_storm.intro: Your magic and the spire's lightning made something new: a storm that thinks. It fills the Coil Chamber with eyes of ball lightning.
storm_engine_living_storm.victory: The Living Storm discharges into the copper floor all at once, and the chamber goes quiet.
storm_engine_living_storm.arrival_omen: The sky over the spire is a permanent thunderhead now, and it moves against the wind.
storm_engine_living_storm.arrival_rumour: A storm with a mind lives in the Lightning Engine. It follows travellers along the west road.

study.text: It has to ground itself to strike. Stand on the rubber mats.

storm_engine_copper_titan.title: the Copper Titan
storm_engine_copper_titan.intro: The spire has built itself a body. The Copper Titan is made of coils and wire, and when it moves the lights of Verath dim.
storm_engine_copper_titan.victory: The Copper Titan sags like a puppet with its strings cut.
storm_engine_copper_titan.arrival_omen: The coils have unwound from the spire and lie coiled on the floor of the chamber, moving slightly.
storm_engine_copper_titan.arrival_rumour: The Lightning Engine has made itself a body of copper. The lights in Verath flicker when it walks.

study.text: It draws power from the crowning sphere. Get under it and cut the feed line.

gates.name: the Thaumic Reactor
gates.description: A sealed facility from before the Fracture, where someone tried to make the arcane arts into fuel. The rift around it glows a faint, sick green.
gates.entry_text: Warning signs in an old language line the walls. Your skin tingles, then itches. The System adds a status: THAUMIC EXPOSURE (MILD).

rooms.text: Workers in torn uniforms shamble towards you, their skin glowing green.
A corridor flooded with green mist from a cracked pipe.

check.success: You hold your breath and push through, and pick up a lump of slag on the way.
check.fail: You breathe in the mist, and it burns all the way down.

rooms.text: Sentinels in sealed suits guard the containment doors, still following their last orders.

thaumic_reactor_director.title: Director {name}
thaumic_reactor_director.intro: In the control room, a man in a lab coat that glows as brightly as he does looks up from the console. 'You can't shut it down,' says Director {name}. 'We're so close to a breakthrough.'
thaumic_reactor_director.victory: The Director slumps over the console. The reactor whines, rising.

study.text: He is part of the reactor now. Every surge hurts him too.

aftermath.label: Leave the reactor running.
aftermath.text: The whine settles into a steady hum. The breakthrough continues without him.

aftermath.label: Pull the emergency rods and shut the reactor down.
aftermath.text: Alarms. Steam. Then silence, and the green light dies.

thaumic_reactor_meltdown.title: the Meltdown Elemental
thaumic_reactor_meltdown.intro: Nobody shut it down. The reactor's core has burst its casing and taken a shape: a figure of molten green light that leaves glass footprints.
thaumic_reactor_meltdown.victory: The Meltdown Elemental cools in an instant into a statue of green glass, and cracks.
thaumic_reactor_meltdown.arrival_omen: The containment doors are bulging outward, glowing hot. The floor has started to melt.
thaumic_reactor_meltdown.arrival_rumour: The Thaumic Reactor is melting down. The grass for a mile around it has turned to glass.

study.text: It's unstable. Make it exert itself and it starts to come apart.

thaumic_reactor_survivors.title: the Survivors' Commune
thaumic_reactor_survivors.intro: With the reactor cold, the mutants who survived it have made it a home. Overseer {name} leads them, and they do not want you to take their power away again.
thaumic_reactor_survivors.victory: Overseer {name} lowers their weapon. 'Fine,' they say. 'Fine. But we'll be back.'
thaumic_reactor_survivors.arrival_omen: Mutants are clearing the debris from the dead core. Someone has painted HOME on the containment door.
thaumic_reactor_survivors.arrival_rumour: The mutants of the Thaumic Reactor have made a commune there. They don't like visitors.

study.text: They are afraid, not cruel. Show them you are leaving.

thaumic_reactor_fuel_god.title: the Fuel-God
thaumic_reactor_fuel_god.intro: Something answered the reactor's call. The System labels it ENTITY - UNKNOWN. It is very large, very green, and it is drinking the core.
thaumic_reactor_fuel_god.victory: The Fuel-God withdraws into the core like a tide going out. The rift dims.
thaumic_reactor_fuel_god.arrival_omen: The reactor core is pulsing again, though nobody restarted it. Something on the other side of it is drinking.
thaumic_reactor_fuel_god.arrival_rumour: Something came through the Thaumic Reactor's core. The System won't name it.

study.text: It is feeding. Interrupt the feeding.
